subject: Pause trial timer requested while finance validates PO
messages:
From: Annie Kline <annie.k@medivance.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-25T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request to pause trial timer while PO under review

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Medivance team is excited to move forward. Our procurement group started routing the PO this morning but they flagged a required vendor validation step that will add about a week to the approval timeline. I attached the PO draft for your reference.

Can Redwood pause the trial timer or provide a short token top-up so our engineers can keep the sandbox running while finance finishes the review? We don't want to lose momentum on the integration. Procurement contact is procurement@medivance.com if you need clarifications.

Appreciate any short-term help — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Annie Kline
Director, Platform Integrations
Medivance

[attachment: PO_draft_medivance.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Annie Kline <annie.k@medivance.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to pause trial timer while PO under review

Hi Annie — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely help preserve your integration work while procurement completes validation. Tentatively we can:
- Pause the trial timer for 7 days from the date you confirm PO submission, OR
- Issue a 3k-token temporary credit to keep the sandbox live (whichever you prefer).

Looping in Camila (CS) to coordinate the pause and David (Finance) to rubber-stamp the credit/extension. Camila — if we pause the timer, do you want any additional onboarding hours or check-ins while the PO routes? David — please advise if 3k tokens is within our playbook for PO-validated prospects; otherwise suggest an amount.

Annie, if you can reply with which option you prefer and a target PO upload link or expected clearance date, we’ll action it immediately.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0192

[trial-terms-AVA-v2.docx referenced for internal approval]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-27T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to pause trial timer while PO under review

On Sep 25, 2027, Ava Chen wrote:
> We can absolutely help preserve your integration work while procurement completes validation.
> Tentatively we can pause the trial timer for 7 days or issue a 3k-token temporary credit.

Ava / David — quick note from CS perspective: Medivance has been actively testing streaming and model routing in the sandbox; losing the environment will cause the team to fall behind on the scheduled sprint. My recommendation is to pause the timer (safer for preserving state and KV cache) and offer one 60-minute office hours session early next week to cover any flaky prompts. If Finance prefers a numeric credit instead, I'm fine with 3k tokens but would prefer the pause to avoid re-setup work for the customer.

If David approves the pause on our end, I can set the tenant flag so they won't hit a hard expiration while we wait for the PO.

—Camila
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Annie Kline <annie.k@medivance.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmation: temporary pause approved while PO validation completes

Hi Annie — copying Ava and Camila back in with an update.

Thanks for sending the PO draft earlier. Finance reviewed the request and approved a temporary pause of the trial timer for 10 days, effective today (2027-10-02). During that window the Medivance sandbox tenant will remain active and token consumption will not advance the public trial expiry.

Action items / next steps:
1) Medivance: please upload the signed PO or share the DocuSign link when available (we've attached the trial terms for signature).
2) Camila: please schedule a 60-min office hours session for next week to help address any integration questions.
3) Ava: I'll log the extension against deal DL-98341-MED and release the temporary hold once PO is verified.

If the PO clears earlier we’ll lift the hold and convert usage to the paid tenant automatically; if PO stalls past the 10-day window we can revisit an interim credit or a short extension upon request.

Best regards,
David Kim
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
finance@redwood.com
